Description
: Discover the fascinating world of geology with this vintage boxed set of 20 assorted rock and mineral specimens. Each specimen, neatly labeled in its own compartment, includes classics such as Azurite, Barite, Quartz, Mica, Iron Pyrite, and more, offering a colorful and educational display for collectors, students, or enthusiasts.
The collection comes in its original cream-colored sturdy box, making it ideal as a gift for budding geologists or as a unique display item for your collection. Individual stones are unmounted and vary in size and shape, showcasing their natural textures and hues. Measuring approximately 7.5 x 5.5 inches, the set is compact for easy storage or display.
Whether you're starting a collection or expanding your geological library, this authentic vintage set combines educational value and timeless appeal. Bid with confidencean original and complete collector's item preserved in excellent condition.
